name: SkyPulse Arcade
subtitle: Flight, Relays & Hacking
promotionalText: Fly the Endless Route, restore Pulse Relay circuits and solve Blackout Protocol puzzles. Complete four daily tasks for five crystals each, up to 20 per UTC day.
description:
Created by Mcaulee Maddison, SkyPulse Arcade brings three ways to play to one offline collection of mechanical birds.

ENDLESS ROUTE
Tap to flap through the existing endless flight challenge. Pass gates, collect crystals and pursue your personal best. Travel through twelve environments, changing every 15 gates before the route repeats. These worlds are environments within the Endless Route, not twelve separate game modes.

PULSE RELAY
Restore an authored flight circuit. Collect gold Pulse-charge cells, align with numbered relay windows, then use a separate Pulse control to spend a charge and open the next shutter. Activate the relays in order and fly through the exit. Optional cells invite a different flight line. Begin with First Circuit, then tackle Switchback, Highwire and Crossfeed. Completion saves medals; Pulse charges are separate from wallet crystals.

BLACKOUT PROTOCOL
Plan your route through a luminous green terminal grid. Tap adjacent nodes, recover required data packets and reach the exit within the trace budget. Spend limited hack charges to open firewalls, or follow a safer route. Every move adds one trace; each hack adds three trace without moving. Start with Packet Recovery, then solve Firewall Fork, Quiet Bypass and Dark Weave. Four authored puzzles save their own medals and do not alter your Endless best.

MISSION CONTROL
Track four daily tasks across attempts. Each completed task can be claimed once for exactly five crystals, with a maximum of 20 daily-task crystals per UTC day. Tasks require no login, purchase or unlocked upgrade. Progress and claims save locally; the next reset is shown in local time. The offline daily clock is not a server-backed anti-cheat system.

YOUR COLLECTION
Unlock 15 cosmetic birds with earned crystals. Every bird shares the same flight handling. Spend crystals across nine existing Tech Tree nodes with three levels each for the Endless collection and reward effects described in the game. These upgrades do not grant hacking abilities.

Play in portrait on iPhone and iPad, with Reduced Motion and haptic controls. No account, advertising or real-money purchases. Scores, crystals, birds, upgrades, preferences, mission medals and daily progress are stored on your device.

Home starts on Endless Route. Tap the top-left mode badge to expand the three free modes, select one, then press Play. Home changes its scenery and lighting to match the selection. Pulse Relay shares SkyPulse's cinematic environments and textured mechanical artwork. Reduced Motion keeps ambient effects steady.
